We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

About Us

ClearBank is a technology‑enabled, fully regulated bank providing cloud‑based banking and payments infrastructure to financial institutions. We operate at scale in a highly regulated environment, where trust, resilience and security are critical.

Our engineering organisation is focused on enabling frequent, reliable change while maintaining strong controls. We believe quality is not a gate at the end of delivery, but something designed in from the very start.

Role Purpose

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the strategy, design, build, operation and ongoing resilience of ClearBank’s payments and cards platforms.

The VP of Payments & Cards will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for real-time, scheme-connected payments and cards systems across the UK, Europe, and future international markets. This requires deep experience working close to the infrastructure that moves money. Ideally, this will include direct integration with major payment schemes or rails, such as FPS, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK, SEPA payment schemes in Europe, or ACH and Fedwire in the US. We will also consider experience gained through payment infrastructure providers or connectivity platforms provided it includes sufficient technical depth in payment processing, scheme connectivity and the operation of highly available, regulated payments infrastructure. The role will define platform strategy, engineering standards, tooling and ways of working, while embedding a shift-left quality mindset across delivery. Success means delivering highly resilient, highly available, secure, scalable and compliant platforms that enable frequent, reliable change in a regulated banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, design, build and run of real-time payments and cards platforms across the UK, Europe, the US and future international markets, including direct scheme connectivity and integrations with third-party payment infrastructure providers.

  • Lead the delivery and operation of digital wallet capabilities, including Apple Pay and Google Pay implementations.

  • Set the technical direction for payments and cards platforms, ensuring architectural choices support resilience, availability, scalability, performance, security and cost efficiency.

  • Own the budget for the Payments and Cards engineering teams, ensuring effective investment in people, tooling and platforms.

  • Build, lead and develop high-performing engineering teams, creating clear accountability, strong delivery discipline and a culture of engineering excellence.

  • Ensure platforms are designed and operated to meet the following outcomes:

  • Highly resilient — supporting local and cross-region disaster recovery requirements.

  • Highly available — targeting 99.999% aggregate internal availability where appropriate.

  • Highly scalable — supporting aggressive growth targets and future business volumes.

  • Performant — meeting scheme performance requirements and exceeding client expectations on latency.

  • Cost optimised — balancing client value, operational efficiency and ClearBank’s cost base.

  • Establish scalable engineering quality standards, practices and governance across the payments and cards domain.

  • Embed quality, observability, operational readiness and control requirements into delivery practices and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive engineering productivity through AI-assisted and increasingly agentic software engineering, including the effective use of AI coding tools and multi-agent approaches across development, testing and engineering workflows, with appropriate risk, security and regulatory guardrails.

  • Partner closely with the CTO, engineering leaders, product, risk, compliance and operations teams to ensure delivery decisions balance pace, quality and control.

  • Ensure software development and platform operations meet regulatory, audit, resilience and compliance expectations.

jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Nachunternehmer

Cosuno ist die größte Plattform, auf der Auftraggeber im Bau ihre Projekte ausschreiben und Handwerksbetriebe neue Aufträge finden. Der Nachunternehmer-Bereich ist unser am schnellsten wachsender Bereich, und 2027 wollen wir den Umsatz verdoppeln. Dafür suchen wir Closer, keine Verwalter.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity at Beamery

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Beamery's Data Foundry end to end. The Data Foundry is our proprietary data platform, powering existing and emerging product lines including our Talent CRM and Workforce Suite. Through this, we provide data-as-a-service to customers through channels such as MCP/API. This is an emerging commercial channel. Its core capabilities span the data models, taxonomies and integrations that underpin talent and workforce decisions across our platform.

The Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry will treat data both as infrastructure embedded within our products and as a product that customers buy in its own right. Beyond internal embedding and direct commercial sales, the platform is open — customers and partners can build on top of it through MCP and API access. You will work with product leadership to set the strategy, agree what the platform provides internally, decide what becomes customer-facing, and define how the platform opens up for customer and partner innovation.

You will work at the centre of the platform, creating a balance between two essential initiatives. On one side, you serve the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite product managers as your customers, agreeing the data contracts they build on. On the other, you partner with the data science, data engineering and integrations engineering leads to turn those needs into delivery.

What you will be doing

Ownership and strategy

  • Own the Data Foundry vision, strategy and roadmap, framing each item as a bet with a clear driver, aligned to overall strategic objectives

  • Ensure alignment of Data Foundry strategy to Beamery's AI strategy, reflecting the shift from providing AI assistants to providing AI access through MCP and API channels.

  • Decide what Data Foundry provides as internal infrastructure and what is packaged and sold as a customer-facing product.

  • Make and defend build versus buy decisions across integrations, analytics, AI and taxonomy capabilities.

Discovery and commercial impact

  • Discover and validate what external customers want from data-as-a-service, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive adoption with clear GTM and enablement plans

  • Build the case for Data Foundry as a new commercial channel, defining and proving the standalone commercial model alongside its role as platform foundation, quantify the value it unlocks for specific customers and deals, and measure success against value and usage metrics.

Partnership and delivery

  • Lead your team to deliver solutions our customers can’t imagine working without and that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Agree and maintain the data contracts with the CRM and Workforce Suite product managers, treating them as internal customers with real commitments.

  • Prioritise across data science, data engineering and integrations engineering, translating tribe needs into a clear and deliverable plan.

Communication & alignment

  • Communicate transparently and create alignment between peers and leadership on priorities, trade offs and progress

  • Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

Data governance and trust

  • Own how workforce data is governed, secured and access-controlled as it is exposed through APIs and MCP, meeting or exceeding enterprise privacy and compliance expectations.

  • Ensure the outputs of Data Foundry's models are measurable and explainable, so customers and internal teams can trust and act on the results.

What we are looking for

  • A product manager with a minimum 6 years experience in complex technical, data or AI products, a significant portion of which should be in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Strong grasp of data platforms, APIs and integrations, comfortable making architecture-adjacent decisions while collaborating with and holding priorities with engineering and data science leads.

  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data, with a clear view of governance, security and privacy.

  • An analytical thinker who uses data to find opportunities, confidently prioritise and measure success, balancing between competing tribe roadmaps and internal customers.

  • Commercially fluent, experience with 0-1 product stages, shaping early product with new go to market motions, able to connect product decisions to revenue, cost and customer ROI.

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across product, data science and engineering, and who is comfortable taking a position and explaining the reasoning.

  • Experienced owning and delivering AI capabilities, with a keen interest in how AI is reshaping the talent and workforce space, and in giving customers trusted, explainable access to their data.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. If, for whatever reason, you need us to make reasonable adjustments and adaptations to our recruitment process, please email Visit our Diversity, Equality and Inclusion page to learn more about progress and commitments.

jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA
jobs.description:
Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA

The Role

Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders.

This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Lyrebird’s clinical safety management system for the UK and Ireland, ensuring DCB0129 compliance, supporting customers with DCB0160, and providing senior oversight of our Clinical Safety Officers.

  • Bring the clinical voice into the product roadmap, defining UK- and Ireland-specific workflows and leading clinical validation of new models, features and specialty templates before release.

  • Own clinical incident management and chair our clinical governance and safety committee, reporting to the leadership team and board.

  • Advise on the regulatory landscape, including MHRA medical device regulation, NHS England guidance on ambient voice technology, DTAC, and the EU AI Act for Ireland.

  • Design and deliver a clinical evidence strategy, running evaluations and real-world studies with NHS and academic partners, publishing the results, and always reporting limitations honestly.

  • Act as a trusted clinical peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and digital leaders across NHS trusts, ICBs and the HSE, and represent Lyrebird at conferences, in the media and in national policy conversations.

  • Bring clinical credibility to the commercial team by leading the clinical, safety and evidence sections of tenders, supporting pilots, and making sure every clinical claim we make stands up.

  • Build and lead a UK and Ireland clinical team, and champion equity, patient safety and inclusive design across languages, accents and patient groups.

What you’ll bring

  • Full GMC registration with a licence to practise, in good standing.

  • Significant senior clinical leadership experience in the NHS, such as Medical Director, Deputy or Associate Medical Director, or Clinical Director.

  • Substantial digital health or clinical informatics leadership, for example as a CCIO, CMIO or senior clinical lead on an EPR or digital transformation programme.

  • In-depth, practical knowledge of DCB0129 and DCB0160, clinical risk management, hazard logs and safety cases, plus a solid grasp of MHRA, DTAC, DSPT and NHS England AI guidance.

  • A track record of designing, leading or publishing clinical evaluations, audits or research.

  • Strong NHS networks and the ability to explain complex clinical, technical and regulatory issues clearly to boards, clinicians, engineers and patients.

Nice to have

  • Accredited Clinical Safety Officer training, and continuing clinical practice alongside the role.

  • Experience in a health tech, MedTech or digital health company, ideally including evaluation of AI or NLP safety and performance.

  • Knowledge of the EU AI Act, EU MDR and the Irish health system, or registration with the Medical Council of Ireland.

  • Membership or fellowship of the Faculty of Clinical Informatics, or a national profile through the Royal Colleges, NHS England or a Health Innovation Network.

  • Familiarity with clinical coding (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, OPCS-4), PRSB standards or the NICE Evidence Standards Framework.

Every minute a clinician spends on documentation is a minute taken from their patients. In this role, you’ll help decide how ambient AI is safely adopted across the NHS and in Ireland, setting the standards that protect patients while giving clinicians time back to focus on care.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms.

In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. Your work will enable silicon bring-up, hardware validation, remote access, observability, and platform automation for our validation platforms and production systems.

You will work across hardware and software domains, collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, validation, firmware, and system teams to ensure our in-house accelerator silicon can be brought up, debugged, validated, and accessed efficiently.

This is a hands-on role combining embedded development, hardware integration, laboratory debugging, and technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards.

· Evaluate, select, and integrate MCUs, management controllers, sensors, and supporting hardware components.

· Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation.

· Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks.

· Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams.

· Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements.

· Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity.

· Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities.

· Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.

· Support manufacturing test, firmware provisioning, and lifecycle management processes.

· Drive technical execution across multiple projects while contributing to architecture, risk reduction, and long-term platform strategy.

· Generate design documentation, validation procedures, and engineering guidelines.

Minimum Qualifications:

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

· 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware and software.

· Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ development.

· Solid understanding of digital hardware design and board-level electronics.

· Experience reading and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and hardware interface specifications.

· Familiarity with I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART, GPIO, JTAG, and other common embedded interfaces.

· Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment.

· Experience with Linux-based development environments.

· Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualificacions:

· Experience with OpenBMC, embedded Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar platforms.

· Experience developing board management controllers, service processors, or platform management solutions.

· Experience supporting silicon bring-up, board bring-up, or hardware validation programs.

· Familiarity with data center, server, networking, accelerator, or HPC hardware.

· Understanding of power sequencing, PMBus, telemetry, monitoring, and voltage margining concepts.

· Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and other high-speed platform interfaces.

· Experience developing automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.

· Exposure to manufacturing test, production provisioning, and deployment workflows.

· Knowledge of secure boot, firmware update mechanisms, and remote-management architectures.

Soft skills:

· A systems-level mindset spanning both hardware and software.

· Strong technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges.

· The ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines.

· Sound engineering judgment and a pragmatic approach to problem solving.

· Ownership and accountability for delivering robust platform management solutions that enable successful silicon bring-up and platform validation.

What We Offer?

· A chance to work at one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe with cutting-edge technology and industry leaders

· We offer a remuneration package that values your experience

· We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development

· Join an innovative team and experience company growth

· Travel within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia, to work with our teams and partners

We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you identify with Openchip, please contact us.

At Openchip, we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division. 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries.
  • Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.
  • Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have)

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.
  • Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

  • Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets.
  • Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

  • Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions.
  • Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Performance Manager to join our Performance Service.

tem is growing fast. Our goal is to get better as we get bigger - revenue growing faster than headcount. In practice that means keeping our strongest people engaged and performing, getting new joiners productive quickly, and enabling our leaders to multiply their impact over time. Most companies solve that with layers of management. We don't. Our leaders (Player-Coaches) coach their teams while staying hands-on with the work, which means the systems around them have to do more of the lifting. That's where the Performance Service comes in.

We're a team of four, and we own how tem runs as an organisation: the operating rhythm (how work gets planned, tracked, escalated and reported), the onboarding and development that build capability, the frameworks that define what good performance looks like and how people progress and get paid, and the operational backbone of contracts, benefits and payroll. We don't own recruitment. We're adding a second Performance Partner because we need more hands on deck - both partnering with our leaders day to day, and building the frameworks that support them.

Your patch is sustained performance - the part that runs continuously once someone is through the door. You'll carry a portfolio of leaders across our Engines and Services that you're accountable for, and you'll co-own the frameworks that sit underneath them alongside the rest of the team. You will not be handed a finished playbook to administer. You'll report into the Performance Service Manager. HR experience is welcome but not required - we're open to operators, people who've led teams, and the sort of person who ends up owning whatever the company needs next.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Become the first call for a portfolio of leaders on anything to do with their people - performance calls, team decisions and hard conversations.

  • Co-design how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team.

  • Handle live cases end to end - performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, and measure whether they work.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Coach and challenge: be a leader's first call on anything to do with their people - a decision they want a second view on, coaching on how to handle a situation, or a read on employment law - and hold a position when you disagree with them.

  • Raise the bar: hold leaders to a high standard on performance, potential, pay and progression - help them make sharper calls, and hold consistency across your patch.

  • Handle live cases end to end: performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Build to delight: shape how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. We treat our people like top athletes, and our aim is to delight them at every step of their employee experience - the systems around them have to express that at every contact point.

  • Design for our shape, not the textbook: we index on outcomes and impact in everything - how progression works, how teams are structured, what leaders spend their time on. Most standard people frameworks assume a management hierarchy we don't have.

  • Automate the repeatable: use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Think in process, scalability and iteration: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service. Measure whether they work and redesign when they don't fit the purpose.

✅ Requirements

You do not need a CIPD qualification, and you do not need to have worked in a large, established HR function. You might have been a founder's associate or Chief of Staff at a Series A or B startup, holding the place together while it scaled. You might have built a People function from scratch and taken it from a one-person band to a well-oiled machine. You might have run a team or an Operations function where the people calls were effectively yours, even if People or HR never appeared in your job title. Or you might have done a different job that helped you build the skills below. A background in HR might help you do this job well, but it is not a requirement.

Must-Haves

  • You've held real accountability for decisions on people - you've partnered with leaders, or managed a team yourself, where hiring, performance and exit calls were either yours or made on your guidance.

  • You can be trusted with the hardest conversations in the business and you're recognised for how you handle them, and you understand how decisions about people shape culture and employer brand - balancing efficiency with empathy.

  • You've worked in or towards building a high-performance culture, and you're a confident challenger who carries conviction and can influence leadership decisions.

  • You're comfortable operating without a playbook, in a company where the requirements and the shape of your role change constantly.

  • You think from first principles, get to the root cause of complex problems, weigh competing considerations and anticipate second-order consequences.

  • You're fluent with Notion, automation and AI tooling - your instinct is to build the thing rather than do it manually a second time - and you write clearly enough that a busy person reads it once and comes away with a clear idea of the situation and the next actions.

Desirable

  • Employment relations experience in the UK, Europe or the US - we operate across the UK and Europe today, with plans to expand to the US soon.

  • Experience working across multiple countries, including employer of record arrangements.

  • Compensation and benchmarking experience - salary banding, pay review cycles, market data.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with our Talent team.

  • Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise we may ask you to prepare in advance.

  • Hiring Manager interview.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. jobs.title: Venture Development
jobs.description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff.

Why this role exists

We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff).

Why your role matters

  • You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company.

  • You see every part of the company. You interact with Sales, Tech and Customer Value roles and learn fast what great looks like in each.

  • AI does the groundwork, you bring the judgement. Our agents search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, check what they find and raise their bar.

  • You grow as fast as you deliver. 70%+ of our leadership team was promoted internally. After your first year, you shape your own path: in Talent, Ops, Tech or in a commercial role.

What your week looks like

  • Interviews: about 40%

  • Steering and reviewing sourcing: about 20%

  • Candidate communication and scheduling: about 10%

  • Events, campaigns, merch and employer branding: about 20%

  • Other: about 10%

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: The first 9 to 12 months are about execution: many interviews and candidate calls, clean pipelines and events that run smoothly. It's not always glamorous, but some of the highest leverage work at Tacto and that's how we like it.

  • Not a closing role: Offers and final negotiations sit with our Chief of Staff and the hiring managers. Your job is to bring the right people to the final round, with a clear picture of who they are and making sure that everybody is aligned to provide the best possible candidate experience we can.

  • Not a strategy role: Those don’t exist at Tacto. It is also not a short stop: we look for people who want to grow here. Where you want to grow and into which direction you want to take your career is up to you to define.

  • The deal: Prove yourself with real impact, and we back your growth in every way we can.

Your tasks

  • Own your pipelines and build the org: You own a few open roles at a time, often in very different teams. You agree with each hiring manager on who we are looking for and keep the pipeline moving until the final interview.

  • Interview and assess: You run first interviews, judge fit against a clear bar and give hiring managers a sharp recommendation.

  • Orchestrate sourcing: Our AI skills search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, review what they find and source yourself where it counts.

  • Turn candidates into fans: You make our process fast, personal and honest, from the first message to the final interview. Even the people we say no to should walk away telling their friends to apply.

  • Build a base that scales: You set up job descriptions, interview plans, pipelines and data that let us grow the team without losing speed or quality. What you build today is how Tacto hires tomorrow.

  • Shape how Tacto shows up: You help run our talent events, from hackathons and university partnerships to invite-only dinners and Lunch & Learns, plus campaigns, merch and employer branding.

  • Grow into company building: Once the basics run, you take on additional projects with our Chief of Staff. Your path is yours to define in this role and you will receive all the support needed to make it happen.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Ideally 1 to 2 years of work experience, but not required

  • High bar: You’ve seen what great looks like, through an internship or role at a top startup, in consulting or in VC

  • AI native: You already use AI in your daily work and want to build with it, not just use it

  • Languages: Fluent German and English

Core strengths

  • People intuition: You read people fast, connect easily and build trust

  • Storyteller: You sell a vision and get others excited to join it

  • Hands on: You solve problems yourself instead of only talking about them

  • Hungry and fast: You get energy from moving fast and seeing results

  • Curious about company building: You want to understand how companies grow and can see yourself in Talent or org building long term

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events, for example with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or at large hackathons. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro Call, 20 min, with the People Team

  2. Hiring Manager Interview, 30 min, with Marla (Chief of Staff)

  3. Mini Task, 30 min prep + 30 min call, with Marla

  4. Onsite Case and Meet the Team, 4-5h prep + 1.5h at our office, with Marla, André, and two people from the team

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The role

Every parcel through our sort centres is handled by an operative. At peak, we need to hire up to 600 of them a week.

As Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition you'll own operative supply across our sortation sites: enough suitable, trained, compliant and active operatives to fill every shift. You'll build the funnel, reporting and automation that make supply repeatable rather than manual, and keep it ahead of demand as volume rises.

Volumes rise sharply into November and December. Supply, not demand, will be the constraint. This role exists to make sure it isn't.

You'll be the single owner of the operative funnel, working across acquisition (including paid channels), Live Operations, our site teams, and Product and Engineering, who build the integrations the funnel runs on. You'll write SQL, ship automation, and spend time at our sort centres seeing how new starters actually land.

What you'll do

  • Own the operative funnel end to end, from applicant attraction through qualification, training, activation and retention

  • Keep applicant supply ahead of site demand, forecasting how many applicants, training places and sessions are needed and directing spend where gaps exist

  • Improve qualification and compliance, owning Right to Work/KYC and working with Product and Engineering to reduce drop-off and speed up the process

  • Optimise training capacity and waitlists, making sure sessions are filled and candidates stay engaged

  • Get new starters onto shift quickly, supporting activation, shift fill, communications and low-fill processes

  • Reduce cancellations, no-shows and inactivity, using the root causes to improve communications, processes and policies

  • Own operative communications and compliance processes, including waitlist messaging, suspensions, strikes and shift-booking comms

  • Build clear funnel reporting and alerts, tracking volumes, conversion, time to hire and drop-off by site to identify issues early

Who Will Thrive in this role?

  • A growth or operations background. You treat supply as a daily number and act the same day it slips

  • Confident in SQL (BigQuery or similar). You build dashboards from raw data, not static trackers

  • Experience running a high-volume hiring or onboarding funnel, ideally for a frontline workforce

  • A working understanding of Right to Work checks, enough to see how checks and re-checks affect the funnel and operative status. Legal owns the detail, but this can't be a blank

  • Clear writing. You can write processes, requirements and comms that other teams rely on

  • Experience using data to identify trends and improve outcomes”.

Desirable

  • Comfortable with paid acquisition, Google Ads or similar, enough to read performance and brief changes when a site runs short

  • Experience onboarding couriers or drivers at a carrier or delivery platform

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering on integrations or APIs

  • Experience with predictive or candidate-quality modelling

  • Strong forecasting skills and an understanding of seasonality

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that.
