We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

jobs.title: Accounting & Reporting Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

EFS is a fintech company specialising in the financing of decentralised energy solutions such as photovoltaic systems and heat pumps. As a factoring and leasing company and an independent subsidiary of the Enpal Group, we enable installation companies and project developers to offer simple instalment and financing solutions to their customers.

Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition through accessible and customer-focused financing products.

What you’ll do

As an Accounting & Reporting Manager (f/m/x), you will be the key accounting expert for Enpal Financial Services (EFS). You will take ownership of HGB and IFRS accounting, financial reporting, month-end and year-end closing processes, and the continuous development of scalable accounting operations.

  • Own and coordinate the monthly and annual closing processes for EFS and ensure accurate, high-quality financial reporting.

  • Ensure compliance with HGB and IFRS, including the preparation of IFRS reporting adjustments.

  • Support the preparation of statutory financial statements and group reporting requirements.

  • Coordinate consolidation and reporting activities with Enpal Group Finance and relevant stakeholders.

  • Drive the automation, standardisation and scalability of accounting and reporting processes.

  • Oversee the accounting treatment of financing, receivables, leasing and factoring-related transactions.

  • Support accounting topics related to SPVs, securitisation and financing structures where required.

  • Coordinate tax and VAT compliance together with external advisors and internal stakeholders.

  • Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.

  • Act as the key accounting partner for EFS management and stakeholders across the Enpal Group.

  • Translate complex accounting topics into practical recommendations for business stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of relevant experience in Accounting, Financial Reporting, Group Accounting, Audit, or a comparable finance function.

  • Strong knowledge of HGB and IFRS as well as month-end, year-end and statutory reporting processes.

  • Experience with financial reporting, consolidation and closing activities.

  • Proven experience improving, simplifying and automating accounting processes.

  • A hands-on, pragmatic and solution-oriented working style with a high degree of ownership.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to explain complex accounting matters in a clear and practical way.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential, regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Special Operations Agent plays a vital back-office role, managing Lendable’s correspondence and administration with the third parties involved in our customers’ accounts. These include debt management companies, insolvency practitioners, credit reference agencies, debt purchasers and incoming post, across our UK Unsecured Loans, UK Credit Cards and UK Motor Finance products. You will follow detailed procedures to process a high volume of third-party requests accurately and efficiently.

By taking ownership of every task and request from third parties, from receipt to final resolution, through portals, spreadsheets, email and post, you will make sure that customers in debt solutions or Breathing Space are protected, credit files are accurate, and Lendable meets its legal and regulatory obligations. You will also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and processes. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves, with a focus on keeping clear and complete records for audit and adhering to compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process Debt Management Plan (DMP) proposals, balance requests and terminations from debt management companies via portals, spreadsheets and bulk upload tools

  • Administer insolvency cases, including IVAs, Trust Deeds, bankruptcies, Debt Relief Orders and Scotland’s Debt Arrangement Scheme, including proofs of debt and write-offs

  • Apply Breathing Space protections to accounts and manage each case through to expiry or cancellation

  • Investigate credit file disputes from the credit reference agencies and submit weekly amendments

  • Respond to queries from purchasers of sold debt, including putbacks, buybacks, disputes and document requests, and send them balance adjustments

  • Sort, process and route incoming post, including verifying a third party’s authority to act, handling cheques and escalating urgent or regulatory correspondence

  • Process deceased account notifications and debt consolidation balance requests

  • Record vulnerability disclosures before taking any other action on an account

  • Support frontline colleagues by answering their credit file and third-party queries

  • Meet all deadlines and keep accurate records and a full audit trail of every action and decision

  • Handle sensitive data securely and escalate risks, errors and anything outside the procedure promptly

  • Identify process gaps and give feedback to improve our procedures and automation

  • Complete training and keep up to date with changes to systems, products and procedures

Person Specification

Experience & Skills

  • Experience in a back-office, operations, collections, credit reporting or financial services administration environment

  • Excellent attention to detail, with a disciplined approach to checking your own work

  • Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel or Google Sheets), including working with CSV files, data matching and reconciling figures

  • Confident following detailed, step-by-step procedures while applying judgement when a case doesn’t fit

  • Clear, professional written communication, as most contact is by email

  • Able to manage multiple queues and deadlines in a fast-paced setting and to prioritise accurately

  • Comfortable using multiple portals and internal systems, and adopting new tools, including automation and AI-assisted processes

Behaviours & Approach

  • Methodical and diligent, with a high level of personal accountability for accuracy and outcomes

  • Calm and composed under deadline pressure

  • Willing to ask questions, challenge and escalate when something doesn’t look right

  • Resilient, adaptable and open to constant change and learning

  • Collaborative and supportive of colleagues, committed to shared success

  • Constructive and solutions-focused, with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Desirable

  • Knowledge of UK debt solutions (DMPs, IVAs, DROs, Breathing Space) and credit file reporting

  • Understanding of vulnerable customer considerations, Consumer Duty and data protection

  • Experience working with debt management companies, insolvency practitioners or credit reference agencies

  • Knowledge of AI tools and automation, and an interest in using them to improve how work gets done

The interview process

We’re not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we’d expect:

1) A 15 minute Cognitive Assessment

2) A 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

3) An onsite Interview and Assessment with the Special Operations Team Leader

Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt entweder in Berlin, München oder komplett remote in Deutschland; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms...) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent in English (German is not mandatory)

jobs.title: Responsable d'offres techniques (F/H)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Responsable d’offres techniques (F/H) en CDI pour venir renforcer nos équipes HEMERIA SERVICES au sein de notre division LAND & SEA sur Villebon-Sur-Yvette.

Au cœur de notre développement, vous pilotez la construction de nos offres techniques et commerciales, de l’analyse du besoin client jusqu’à la remise de la proposition. En lien étroit avec le Bureau d’Études, les ingénieurs et les équipes commerciales, vous contribuez aux choix techniques, à la qualité des réponses et au développement de nouvelles offres. 

Missions :

Construire et piloter les offres techniques 

  • Analyser les cahiers des charges, les spécifications clients et les dossiers de consultation afin d’identifier les besoins, les exigences, les contraintes et les risques. 

  • Rédiger les offres techniques et les mémoires techniques en vous appuyant sur les membres du Bureau d’Études (BE), les ingénieurs spécialistes et les experts métiers. 

  • Piloter la définition des solutions techniques proposées et décider des orientations de réponse, en tenant compte de la faisabilité, des performances attendues, des coûts, des délais et des engagements contractuels. 

  • Mobiliser les ingénieurs et les contributeurs internes pour challenger les solutions, instruire les points techniques et construire des réponses robustes et différenciantes. 

  • Consolider les spécifications techniques, les données d’entrée, les architectures et les nomenclatures complètes (BOM) afin de garantir la cohérence et l’exhaustivité des propositions. 

Coordonner les contributeurs et sécuriser les jalons 

  • Organiser et suivre les revues d’offres ainsi que les différents jalons de préparation et de remise, en étroite collaboration avec le responsable commercial. 

  • Assurer la coordination entre les équipes techniques, le BE, les ingénieurs, les experts métiers et les interlocuteurs commerciaux. 

  • Anticiper les points de blocage, identifier les risques et suivre les actions nécessaires au respect des échéances.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer. Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.

Jouw rol

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.

  • Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.

  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.

  • Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.

  • Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.

  • Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.

  • Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.  

  • Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau. Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code. Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact.

  • Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor.

  • Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen Infrastructure Automation & Architecture) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat.

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen.

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt te werken binnen de adviesgroep Transformaties van organisaties. Vanuit verschillende expertisegebieden werken we samen aan complexe veranderopgaven bij onze klanten. Vaak gebeurt dit onder regie van een transformatiepartner of programmamanager.

Wij geloven dat duurzame verandering alleen lukt wanneer strategie, organisatiestructuur, processen, systemen, hr, cultuur en leiderschap in samenhang worden aangepakt. Daarom werken we nadrukkelijk multidisciplinair en zoeken we collega’s die energie krijgen van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en expertise.

Je werkt regelmatig zelfstandig bij de klant, maar bent nooit alleen. Achter je staat een sterk netwerk van collega’s dat je kunt inzetten wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Juist die combinatie van zelfstandigheid, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk zo bijzonder.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build.

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air.

  • Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand.

  • System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

 


What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

    • 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

    • 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

    • 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

    • 5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

    • What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:
  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

    • What You Bring:

    Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

    • Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

    • AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

    • Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

    • Nice to Have:
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

    • How You Will Work:

    You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

    This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

    You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

    Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

    We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

    If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.


    What We Offer:
  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

    Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description:
Swissblock Technologies is a private investment firm dedicated to pioneering cryptocurrency integration with cross-asset investing. Applying a quantitative view to financial markets, we manage systematic multi-strategy portfolios of digital and traditional assets.

Our Systematic Crypto Group transforms market insights into robust algorithmic investment strategies, trading fully automated on our prop trading infrastructure. We are dedicated to a collaborative, non-siloed environment with shared incentives, where each member can directly shape the team’s and company's future.

This role can based from anywhere in Switzerland.

Responsibilities and Objectives
Quantitative Researchers in our Systematic Crypto Group have the opportunity to drive the research process from ideation to final implementation, ultimately specialising according to individual strengths and preferences. This will involve:
- Analyse the crypto ecosystems to uncover the fundamental dynamics that drive price and risk formation.
- Utilise advanced statistical techniques on both traditional and crypto-specific data sets.
- Conceptualised and enhanced monetisation systems for trading signals and other market anomalies.
- Implement, backtest, and deploy algorithmic trading strategies within a live trading environment.
- Monitor live strategy performance and integrate insights into the research loop.
- Participate in the development of our research agenda based on research findings and ideas.

Skills and Talents
- Advanced degree in a highly quantitative field.
- Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail; ability to maintain a pragmatic mindset.
- Passion for traditional and crypto markets; driven to model the underlying market dynamics.
- Ability to conduct data-driven research focused on solving real-world problems.
- Dedication to continuous learning and making an impact; willingness to question the status quo.
- Ability to effectively summarise and clearly communicate research results.
- Prior exposure to quantitative research (preferably in digital assets).
- Proficiency in Python and experience in using statistical packages

Culture
Swissblock Technologies offers an exciting and diverse environment with flat hierarchies and excellent peers. We are a profitable company with a culture based on responsibility and merit. Empowerment of each individual team member is a key value reflected in our career dynamics, which continuously grow with the business.

In addition to a modern office in Baar, Switzerland – flexibility to work remotely within Switzerland – we propose a competitive compensation package, an annual bonus, 25 days of annual leave, progressive social benefits, and engaging company events.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment.


Accountabilities:

As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers.

  • Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams.

  • Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a strong track record of selling SaaS solutions to public sector organizations across the DACH market. You should be comfortable navigating complex procurement processes, engaging senior decision-makers, and managing strategic opportunities with significant commercial value. The following qualifications are expected:

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and successfully close high-value, six- and seven-figure deals.

  • Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, account management, prospecting, and strategic territory planning.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving customer needs, and dynamic market conditions.

jobs.title: Functional Architect – AI-Driven Engineering
jobs.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019. 

The role 

DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product. 

Reporting to the Head of Architecture, you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation. 

This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact. 

Missions: 

  • Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively. 

  • Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails. 

  • Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals. 

  • Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D. 

  • Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review. 

  • Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure. 

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform. 

  • Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working. 

Requirements 

  • Based in France with full working rights. 

  • Fluent in French and English. 

Experience & seniority: 

  • 10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms. 

  • Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history. 

  • Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions. 

  • Legal Tech experience is not required. 

Technical expertise: 

  • Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events. 

  • Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming. 

  • Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin. 

  • Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects. 

  • Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools. 

  • Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed. 

  • Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs. 

Leadership & collaboration: 

  • Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time. 

  • A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models. 

  • Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others. 

  • The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed. 

  • Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams. 

Education: 

Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology. 

Our Tech Stack 

For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role. 

Area

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team. The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS.


What will your job look like:
  • Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. 
  • Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components.
  • Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.
  • Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
  • Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.
  • Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack.
  • Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware.

    • All you need is:
  • Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.  
  • 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work.
  • Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel.
  • Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout.
  • Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch).
  • Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image.
  • Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.
  • Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup.

    • Nice to have:
  • Background in Automotive Software.
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).
  • Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.
